description: 后翼弃兵防御D37 — 关键时机：c5反制时机与Ne4战术时机

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Practice 6
In the Queen's Gambit Declined, White has developed the bishop to f4. When is ...c5 most effective, and when should Black exchange on d4? Track the timing of both the counterbreak and the later knight exchange.
intro.popup:
关键时机练习6

后翼弃兵防御！

白方Bf4位于f4
黑方何时走c5最有力？

练习目标：
识别c5和Ne4的时机

outro.popup_en: Two key moments: play ...c5 once White's bishop is committed to f4, then wait until White's knight occupies d4 before exchanging it. The sequence is setup, central break, then exchange.
outro.popup:
QGD时机总结

两个关键时机：
① c5！：Bf4配置时出击
② Nxd4！：等Nd4入中心后兑换

时机链：布局→中心→兑换！

moves.popup_en: d4 opens with the Queen's Pawn Opening.
c4 offers the Queen's Gambit pawn.
Bf4 places White's bishop on f4.

moves.popup:
c5！时机！
Bf4配置时c5最有力
moves.popup_en: ...c5! The timing is right: with White's bishop committed to f4, Black challenges the center.
...Bxc5 places the bishop on an active square.
cxd5 exchanges pawns in the center.
Rd1 places a rook on the d-file.
Bd3 places White's bishop on an active square.
Nd4! The knight occupies a key central square.

moves.popup:
Nxd4！时机！
等Nd4入位后兑换
moves.popup_en: ...Nxd4! Now that the knight has reached its central outpost, Black exchanges it at the right moment.
exd4 recaptures and establishes White's central pawn structure.
